instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the global company selector in the top navbar that updates all screens instantaneously (State Context or URL query/store).
Strictly honor the dark gold theme: Background #10131B, Card #181C26, Accent #C5A46D, Text Primary #F8FAFC, Text Muted #94A3B8.
Implement the 8 Instagram connection states with visual indicators and diagnostic tools, and provide mock toggle buttons for easy testing of each state.
When a company is disconnected, show a polite lock banner: 'Conecte o Instagram desta empresa para habilitar as funcionalidades.' with a prominent [Conectar agora] button.
Always differentiate real vs demonstrative data using explicit badges (e.g. 'DADOS REAIS' in green pill or 'DEMONSTRAÇÃO' in purple/indigo pill).
Story Studio: 9:16 mobile mockup with live story preview, weekly/monthly calendar switcher, scheduling modal with date/time pickers and retry status badges.
Direct CRM: Unified 3-column inbox (Conversations list, Active Chat with internal notes and quick replies, and Contact details with tags/assigned agent).
Comments Center: Sentiment filter, keyword search, quick canned responses, and manual reply modal.

Automation Builder: Visual interactive node builder (React Flow or customized visual node graph) with triggers (Mensagem, Comentário, Palavra-chave), conditions (Horário comercial, Tag) and actions (Responder, Aplicar Tag, Atribuir).
Reports: Recharts visualizations showing published stories, received comments/DMs, response times, and automated conversions.
Ensure every interactive element and data card has a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default components.
Provide micro-interactions on all hover states and clicks.
Ensure generous padding inside cards (p-5 or p-6) to avoid text collision.
Use Sonner for toasts on successful actions (e.g., 'História agendada com sucesso!', 'Automação ativada!').
Ensure all copy is in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
